# 14 — Review accessibility

## Objective
Identify practical semantic, label, keyboard, validation, and focus concerns.
## Required context and areas
Inspect notice forms, validation output, navigation, and current UI tests.
## Change constraints
Review-only unless a narrow change is explicitly requested. Do not claim conformance.
## Response format
Finding, affected view/line, impact, confidence, manual check, automated test candidate, remediation.
## Assumptions
Do not infer assistive-technology outcomes from source alone.
## Validation and evidence
Perform available keyboard/browser checks; state what was not tested and record human review.
